sections.text:
This procedure details the
steps required to complete and check the proper operation and calibration of the
over current relay type 7TG14 using secondary injection test set.

The
document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing
personal injury or damage to equipment.

The first draft initiated by eng. Hiat 
Farouq Mohamed, tested by eng. Bahaa Eldeen Ramdan & Abdel Fatah Mohamed at 28 
Dec 2003 Transformer no.(3) 220/66kv Sabtia (1) substation, accepted by 
Protection General Director eng. Fikry Ibrahim Salam, 
and approved by eng. Samir Saleh Ismaiel Extra High Voltage Head Sector 
of Cairo zone

A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

items:
A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Equipment isolation, (disconnect switches are opened and
 tagged).

Measure the current circuit of the relay by clip ammeter to
 be sure that is no current.

Make sure CT secondary are shorted before isolation relay
 current circuits for test current injection.
Current injection equipped with timer
Multi meter, Clip meter
Test leads, Tool kit
Review technical reference material (Manufacturer's manual)
Obtain copy of relay setting from field maintenance file

Obtain outage of the equipment (Line or transformer)
 protected by relay
Review station drawing

Check that the bus and equipment disconnect switches are
 opened and tagged
Prepare the test sheet for the tested relay

Short the current circuit of the relay at the C.T side on
 the relay terminals

Isolate the current circuit of the relay for current
 injection, be sure the injection current will flow on the relay under test
 only

Isolate the trip, B.F., fault recorder and any associated
 equipment

Obtain the input terminals of the relay (current terminals)
 and also the output terminals (trip terminals) from the station from the
 station drawing
Inject current phase [terminal (S1-S2)]

Slowly increase the current until the relay pick up and
 record it as a pick up value

Slowly decrease the current until the relay drop off and
 record it as a drop off value

To measure the time connect the out trip contact to stop
 terminals of the tester then inject current equal twice the pick up value
 and record it as an operating time
Repeat the above steps (from 1 to 4) on the others phases
Inject any phase to neutral (for example R-N)

Slowly increase the current until the relay pick up and
 record it is a pick up value (for earth fault)

Measure the time by injection current equal twice the pick up
 value and record it as an operating time.

Service

items:
Disconnect the connection between the relay and the test
 equipment

Connect the current circuit of the relay then remove the

Connect the trip B.F., fault recorder and associated
 equipment

Service

items: Take crossed reading of all AC current
Compare this to the normal loading

Place a copy of the test results in the field maintenance
 file

text:
Introduction
This procedure details the
steps required to complete and check the proper operation and calibration of the
over current relay type 7TG14 using secondary injection test set.
The
document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing
personal injury or damage to equipment.
The first draft initiated by eng. Hiat 
Farouq Mohamed, tested by eng. Bahaa Eldeen Ramdan & Abdel Fatah Mohamed at 28 
Dec 2003 Transformer no.(3) 220/66kv Sabtia (1) substation, accepted by 
Protection General Director eng. Fikry Ibrahim Salam, 
and approved by eng. Samir Saleh Ismaiel Extra High Voltage Head Sector 
of Cairo zone
Safety Precautions
A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
A work permit

Equipment isolation, (disconnect switches are opened and
 tagged).
Measure the current circuit of the relay by clip ammeter to
 be sure that is no current.
Make sure CT secondary are shorted before isolation relay
 current circuits for test current injection.
Tools and Equipment
Current injection equipped with timer
Multi meter, Clip meter
Test leads, Tool kit
Works to be Carried Out
Preparation
Review technical reference material (Manufacturer's manual)
Obtain copy of relay setting from field maintenance file
Obtain outage of the equipment (Line or transformer)
 protected by relay
Review station drawing
Check that the bus and equipment disconnect switches are
 opened and tagged
Prepare the test sheet for the tested relay
Short the current circuit of the relay at the C.T side on
 the relay terminals
Isolate the current circuit of the relay for current
 injection, be sure the injection current will flow on the relay under test
 only
Isolate the trip, B.F., fault recorder and any associated
 equipment
Obtain the input terminals of the relay (current terminals)
 and also the output terminals (trip terminals) from the station from the
 station drawing
Inject current phase [terminal (S1-S2)]
Slowly increase the current until the relay pick up and
 record it as a pick up value
Slowly decrease the current until the relay drop off and
 record it as a drop off value
To measure the time connect the out trip contact to stop
 terminals of the tester then inject current equal twice the pick up value
 and record it as an operating time
Repeat the above steps (from 1 to 4) on the others phases
Testing the Earth Fault Element
Inject any phase to neutral (for example R-N)
Slowly increase the current until the relay pick up and
 record it is a pick up value (for earth fault)
Measure the time by injection current equal twice the pick up
 value and record it as an operating time.
Note: Compare the recorded values with the setting values of the relay
and give your comment
Return Relay and Associated Equipment to 
Service
Disconnect the connection between the relay and the test
 equipment
Connect the current circuit of the relay then remove the
 short circuit at the C.T. side
Connect the trip B.F., fault recorder and associated
 equipment
Request Power Equipment be Return to 
Service
Take crossed reading of all AC current
Compare this to the normal loading
Place a copy of the test results in the field maintenance
 file
